rows.Close the wheel guard properly and tight: Verify oil level and retry. Inspect and reset electric panel breakers. Verify incoming voltage to the hydraulic pump motor and panel button.
Refer to the Electrical Installation section in the 4.1 Installation chapter in this manual.

rows.Close the wheel guard properly and tight: Inspect the proximity sensor is triggereing and is set at the correct distance to the direction switch. The proximity switch can be accessed from underneath the top saddle of the machine after joggign the Y-axis towards the front of the machine.
